svg.title: Student Attendance System - Domain UML Class Diagram

g.text: Student Attendance System - Domain UML Class Diagram
One users table represents all three roles.
Student, lecturer and administrator are roles,
Controller rules: student enrolled_at <= session created_at;
reject a second attendance submission for the same session;
require active, unexpired QR token and distance within radius.
Frontend copies completed coordinates into session creation,
then marks the request used through a separate API call.
There is no stored session/request foreign key in these queries.
Conceptual domain model inferred from controller SQL, not an ORM model.
Types and multiplicities describe application relationships, not verified SQL DDL.
[0..1] denotes an optional value. No schema or migrations are supplied.
No database foreign-key, uniqueness or transaction guarantees are implied.
